stories.summary: Looking for exciting plans in Mumbai this weekend? From spectacular circus performances and coffee celebrations to fun-filled carnivals and special Children's Day activities, the city has plenty to offer from November 13 to 15.

stories.title: Explore Jitish Kallat's new art exhibition in Mumbai at the Dr Bhau Daji Lad Museum in Byculla
stories.summary: For years, there has been a general consensus on the distinct nature of art and sciences. Yet, In Jitish Kallat’s ambitious new exhibition at the Dr Bhau Daji Lad Museum, they find commonality.

stories.title: Looking for something fun to do? Explore these interesting events in Mumbai
stories.summary: Mark the 130th birth anniversary of Dr S lim Ali (right), fondly remembered as the Birdman of India, with a special showcase celebrating his life, work and contribution to ornithology.

stories.title: From Lonavala to Asangaon: Unwind with these three unique trips around Mumbai this weekend
stories.summary: Round up your gang and hit the road to Lonavala in a camping van, with scenic drives and outdoor fun along the way, apart from these other weekend getaways

stories.title: New festival will celebrate the beauty of 8mm films, in Mumbai this December
stories.summary: The recent trend of recreating the 1980s retro nostalgia using AI (Artificial Intelligence) pointed to something far deeper. It reflected a need to return to a time that was not curated for an audience. It is such films and images that are slowly making their way to the Film Heritage Foundation’s labs in Mumbai.

stories.title: The Vvaan 2 announced on Chhath Puja, Ektaa Kapoor to take Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia's folklore fantasy forward with a new universe
stories.summary: The story of The Vvaan is not over yet. Ektaa Kapoor has announced its sequel, The Vvaan 2, on the occasion of Chhath Puja. Following the first film's theatrical run, the makers are now ready to return to its mysterious world and take the story further. Directed by Deepak Kumar Mishra, the first instalment featured Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia.

stories.title: ‘I asked Chhathi Maiya for a little brother’: Shehnaz Shah’s Chhath wish
stories.summary: Sometimes, the most beautiful stories of faith begin with a child's innocent question. Her story was not about following a particular religious tradition or changing one's faith. Instead, it was about childhood innocence, a simple wish and the unexpected happiness that followed. The video also offered a glimpse of the Chhath celebrations around her campus and society, which were decorated with festive colours and decorations.

stories.title: Mumbai: Siddhivinayak Temple Introduces Four New Special Pujas, Fees Go Upto ₹50,000
stories.summary: The newly introduced rituals include Sahasranama Mahaprasad Puja, Sahasranama Ashirvachan Mahapuja, Shringarika Puja and Atharvashirsha Havan. Devotees wishing to perform these pujas or seeking further information can contact the puja booking counter at the temple. The initiative offers devotees an additional opportunity to offer prayers and devotional services at the feet of Lord Ganesha.

stories.title: ‘ISKCON’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Gorak Nath’: 287 ‘other’ religions briefly listed on Census portal
stories.summary: Going by the government's initial classification of “other” religions in the self-enumeration portal for the Population Enumeration phase of Census 2027 , ‘ISKCON’, ‘Ramakrishna Paramahans’, ‘Sanatan’, ‘Shri Ram’, ‘Shri Krishna’, ‘Balmiki’, ‘Ramdev’, ‘Bishnoi’, ‘Sarna’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Yogi’, ‘Shia’, ‘Sunni’, ‘Methodist’, and ‘Pentecostal’, are among the religions practised in the country.

stories.title: Temple for PM Modi’s late mother to come up in Andhra Pradesh’s Kurnool district
stories.summary: A temple dedicated to Heeraben Modi, the late mother of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, is being constructed in Andhra Pradesh’s Kurnool district as a tribute to her, a charitable trust overseeing the project said on Monday, describing it as a symbol of a son’s reverence for his mother.

stories.title: Kalpathy witnesses grand meeting of temple chariots
stories.summary: Thousands of people from across the State and Tamil Nadu gathered at Kalpathy on Monday evening to witness the convergence of temple chariots, marking the finale of the annual car festival. 30 pm. The chariots represented the Viswanathaswamy Temple, Kalpathy; Manthakkara Sree Mahaganapathy Temple, New Kalpathy; Sree Lakshminarayana Perumal Temple, Old Kalpathy; and Sree Prasanna Mahaganapathy Temple, Chathapuram.

stories.title: Thane: 20-year-old man drowns in lake while performing Chhath Puja rituals
stories.summary: A 20-year-old man drowned in a lake in Maharashtra's Thane city while participating in Chhath Puja rituals on Monday morning, officials said. Thane Municipal Corporation ‘s (TMC) disaster management chief, Yasin Tadvi , said that the incident occurred at a lake located inside the Mafatlal Compound, adjacent to the Kalwa railway station, as cited by PTI.

stories.title: Uttarakhands Madhyamaheshwar Dham Closes For Winter; Know Where Devotees Can Seek Darshan?
stories.summary: Madhyamaheshwar Temple or Madmaheshwar is a Hindu temple which is located in Gaundar. It is a village in Rudraprayag district of Uttarakhand. The temple is a part of the Panch Kedar circuit, including Kedarnath, Tungnath, Rudranath, and Kalpeshwar, which is dedicated to Lord Shiva.

stories.title: Tata Power installs battery storage systems in Mahalaxmi, Saki and Mankhurd
stories.summary: Tata Power has operationalised 60 MWh of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) across three strategic locations in Mumbai’s Mahalaxmi, Saki, and Mankhurd to strengthen the city's electricity distribution network and improve power reliability. Officials noted that the installations are expected to help manage peak electricity demand, optimise power procurement costs and improve the resilience of the city's power supply network, which serves more than eight lakh consumers.

stories.title: AQI ‘poor’ in parts of Kolkata, outskirts amid Chhath celebrations
stories.summary: Air quality in parts of Kolkata and its outskirts remained 'poor' on Monday (November 16, 2026) following the bursting of firecrackers during Chhath Puja celebrations in the early morning hours, a West Bengal Pollution Control Board (WBPCB) official said. Barrackpore on the northern fringes of Kolkata recorded an Air Quality Index (AQI) of 230, placing it in the 'poor' category, according to air monitoring data, the official said.

stories.title: Every Chhath, the same question returns: Why is the Yamuna still polluted?
stories.summary: Every year during Chhath Puja, images of devotees standing amid toxic foam bring the Yamuna’s pollution crisis back into focus. Despite decades of court interventions, government plans and cleanup projects, the river remains heavily polluted as it passes through Delhi. Experts say the key challenge is not just increasing river flow, but stopping untreated sewage and waste from entering the river in the first place.

stories.title: Sabarimala temple to open for annual pilgrimage; AI cameras part of crowd management
stories.summary: The sanctum sanctorum of the Sabarimala temple will open on Monday ahead of the annual Mandalam - Makaravilakku pilgrimage season, which begins on November 17. While the pilgrimage season formally begins Tuesday, which marks the first day of the Malayalam month of Vrischikam, the temple doors will open to pilgrims on Monday evening itself.

stories.title: Four workers feared dead in Pandharpur well cave-in; NDRF joins rescue operation | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: Four workers are feared dead after a mound of soil and large rocks collapsed into a nearly 50-foot-deep well while digging work was underway at a farm in Ambe village of Pandharpur taluka in Solapur district on Saturday. A rescue operation is underway to retrieve the trapped workers, with a team from the National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) Pune also joining.

stories.title: Tamannaah Bhatia joins Chhath Puja celebrations in Mumbai, shares video after The Vvaan's festive sequence won hearts
stories.summary: Actor Tamannaah Bhatia recently joined devotees at Chhath Puja celebrations in Mumbai. The actor took to Instagram to share a video from the celebrations, in which she was seen interacting with fans and taking part in the festivities. Tamannaah recently featured in The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest, and the film's Chhath Puja sequence received much love from audiences.

stories.title: Chhath Puja In Japan: Bihari Family Performs Rituals In Tokyo, Offers Arghya To Rising Sun; Videos Go Viral
stories.summary: Thousands of miles away from Bihar, a family from the state brought the spirit of Chhath Puja to Tokyo, Japan, observing the four-day festival with traditional rituals and prayers. Videos of the celebration, showing family members offering Arghya to the rising Sun and singing Chhath songs, have gone viral on social media.

stories.title: Chhath Puja 2026 In Indore Sees Thousands Offer Arghya To Setting Sun At Over 150 Locations Across City
stories.summary: FP photo Indore (Madhya Pradesh): The golden glow of the setting Sun, hundreds of devotees standing waist-deep in water, traditional bamboo baskets filled with offerings and the soulful strains of Chhath folk songs transformed Indore's water bodies into vibrant centres of faith on Sunday evening.

stories.title: Tamannaah Bhatia Graces Juhu Beach To Celebrate Chhath Puja In Dreamy Yellow Anarkali Ensemble
stories.summary: @Tamannaah Bhatia Actor Tamannaah Bhatia joined devotees at Juhu Beach in Mumbai to celebrate Chhath Puja, embracing the festive spirit with warmth and devotion. The actor interacted with people, participated in the celebrations and shared glimpses from the occasion on Instagram, where she received love and affection from those present.
